snippet.title: //Total Chaos Against Apathy// ANNOUNCMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
New very cool game coming very very soon, wishlist on steam :3

Idea this time around is "Tank Controls Are Awesome, lemme show you!", a full action game that only uses 1 stick and 2 buttons!
Control and crush crowds with your weapon of choice!
